svg.title: Physical layout and link speeds of the home network
svg.desc: A 5G gateway feeds a mesh root node over 1 GbE. Three mesh nodes link to each other wirelessly. The workspace node uplinks to an 8-port 2.5G switch. The NAS and the MacBook Pro dock connect at 2.5G, the Mac mini and other adapters at 1G.
svg.text: As of 2026-11-03. Color is the speed each link negotiated. Dashed means wireless or not confirmed.
Runs on every Mac, the NAS,
Direct on this LAN; away from
home it goes through a relay.
1G LAN adapter to the MacBook Pro
Wireless latencies were measured on 2026-11-01 from a wired
machine, before the switch went in. Not re-measured.
